lines.text: Three days after arriving, Festus goes up to Jerusalem, where the chief priests and Jewish leaders ask him to summon Paul.
Festus refuses to summon Paul and tells the leaders to come down to Caesarea and accuse him there.
Festus returns to Caesarea after a month, sits on the judgment seat, and Paul's accusers bring many charges they cannot prove.

wrong_details.true: after no more than eight or ten days

lines.text: Paul says he has committed no offense, and when Festus proposes a trial in Jerusalem, Paul says he should be tried before the council.

wrong_details.true: before the judgment seat of Caesar

lines.text: Paul appeals to Caesar, and after conferring with his council, Festus replies that to Caesar he will go.
